'''Felbar''' was a pet's food popular among pet owners throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were baked and made with [[flower fruit]].<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Antakarian Felbar}}</ref>
